title: Enter does not fire inside textareas - multiline note editing works normally
refs: SV-8700 (§7 (Enter does not fire inside textareas))
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Edit.
2. A shift's detail modal is open with the note editor active.
custom_steps:
1. Type a line of note text and press Enter.
2. Type a second line.
custom_expected:
1. Enter inserts a new line in the note - it does NOT confirm/close the dialog.
2. The multiline note can be completed and saved normally.
